claims.source_title: SpaceX secures approval to launch 15,000 next-gen satellites for Starlink Mobile
claims.supporting_quote: The US Federal Communications Commission (FCC) has approved SpaceX’s application to launch and operate 15,000 next-generation satellites for Starlink Mobile. The regulator granted the request on 6 October, about a year after SpaceX filed it in September 2025.
